Core stack (mandatory)

  • Strong command of state management for high-frequency data (e.g., Zustand, Redux Toolkit, useSyncExternalStore).

 

Real-time data & performance

  • Hands-on with WebSockets / SSE and reconnection/backoff strategies; handling authenticated socket connections and topic resubscriptions.
  • Experience implementing backpressure, buffering, coalescing, and windowing to prevent UI thrash under thousands of updates/minute.
  • Data virtualization (react-virtualized, react-window) for large tables (orders, positions, trades).
  • Familiar with Web Workers / OffscreenCanvas and message passing to keep the main thread responsive.
  • Awareness of latency budgets and frame-time profiling using React DevTools and browser performance tools.

 

Charting & visualization

  • Practical experience with professional charting libs (e.g., TradingView Charting Library, Lightweight Charts, Highcharts, D3).

Auth, security, and roles

  • Role-based feature gating (read-only vs trading permissions).

Testing, quality, and reliability

  • Unit tests for critical transforms/parsers (e.g., Playwright/Vitest for E2E/interaction flows)

reconnect/backoff, authenticated sockets, and topic resubscriptions.

Senior Software Engineer

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who wants to own problem spaces, not just complete tasks. You'll be pointed at areas like "bank reconciliation for legacy ERP customers" and expected to figure out what to build, how to build it, and ship it. You'll make technical decisions that set precedents and shape the systems future engineers inherit.

  • Own entire problem spaces end-to-end: from understanding the user problem to shipping the solution

  • Communicate decisions and progress clearly in writing, working async-first across the team

You're a great fit if you:

  • Treat the product like it's yours — you don't wait for permission to fix something or build something that needs building
  • Think about the people using what you build, and ship useful over elegant
  • Communicate well in writing and stay productive without needing constant real-time feedback
  • Get energized by unclear problems — you ask clarifying questions and move forward, rather than stalling
  • Have picked up new languages, frameworks, and domains throughout your career and enjoy doing so

Technical Requirements

  • Solid backend fundamentals — you've built and shipped production systems
  • Data integration experience across APIs, webhooks, file ingestion, ETL, or similar
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills

  • Graph database or complex data modeling experience
  • Previous early-stage startup experience
  • LLM/agent experience — tool-use patterns, agents that call APIs, document processing
  • Production agent ops experience — evals, tracing, observability, prompt versioning

Our Stack (All Learnable)

  • Golang (backend — Go monolith architecture)
  • Vue/Nuxt (dedicated SSR frontend, though this role is backend-heavy)
  • GCP, PostgreSQL

  • Started identifying what to build next on your own

  • Earned the trust to own a workstream independently
  • Established at least one pattern or practice that makes the codebase better

Headquarters: Brussels, Belgium
URL: https://cloudpepper.io

At Cloudpepper, we build and operate the platform behind 10,000+ Odoo instances. Our control plane is built with Symfony/PHP, our automation runs on Ansible, and the infrastructure underneath is Linux, PostgreSQL, and Nginx.

This is not a pure infrastructure role. We're looking for a senior engineer who can work across both platform and infrastructure: building backend platform features, improving automation, and owning the reliability of production Odoo environments at scale.

Location: Remote (anywhere with CET overlap) or Brussels-based (Belgium)
Compensation: $150,000–$180,000/year
Schedule: Full-time, flexible working hours

What you'll do

  • Design and maintain the Ansible-driven automation behind provisioning, deployment, scaling, backups, and restores
  • Own core parts of our Linux production infrastructure, including performance, scaling, failover, and replication
  • Build and extend platform features in our Symfony-based control plane
  • Be the person who handles production issues when they escalate past support
  • Work directly with the founders on architecture and priorities, with no product manager layer in between

What we're looking for

  • Deep experience with PHP/Symfony
  • Hands-on background in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure-heavy backend roles
  • Comfortable in Linux administration at a production level
  • Fluent with Ansible and infrastructure automation
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL and Nginx: performance tuning, debugging bottlenecks under load, and designing setups that stay reliable at scale
  • Solid grasp of CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
  • Comfortable in Python for tooling and automation
  • Able to debug across application, database, automation, and infrastructure layers
  • Self-directed, takes ownership in a small team
  • Writes clearly: design docs, incident postmortems, async updates that don't need a follow-up call
  • Familiarity with Go and Odoo is a plus

Why join us

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the option to work locally from Brussels
  • High ownership and direct impact on a platform used by thousands of businesses
  • A small, fast-moving team with very little bureaucracy
  • Direct work with the founders, no layers in between

How to apply

Apply at https://cloudpepper.io/careers/platform-engineer/
